Each driver package exposes a `NewDB` constructor that returns a `store.Driver`:

- `mysql.NewDB` in `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`
- `postgres.NewDB` in `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`
- `sqlite.NewDB` in `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go`

`NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` picks among them using `profile.Driver`:

```18:24:store/db/db.go
	switch profile.Driver {
	case "sqlite":
		driver, err = sqlite.NewDB(profile)
	case "mysql":
		driver, err = mysql.NewDB(profile)
	case "postgres":
		driver, err = postgres.NewDB(profile)
```

It is invoked at startup from `cmd/memos/main.go`.
